question: Which parts of the temple complex are included as sites where defilement may require expiation?
premises: Defilement may occur in the temple, sanctum, or intermediate hall.
Defilement may also involve the image or pavilion and similar areas.
inference: These temple areas are all relevant sites for applying the expiation rules.
